title: Template:Clrr/doc
content: ;Description :This template is a shorthand for <div style="clear:right;"></div>. :It moves any content following the template below any objects floating to the right (TOCs, infoboxes, images, etc..). ;Syntax :Type {{t|clrr}} in an article at the point you want the clear. ;See also :{{t|clr}} and {{t|clrl}} [[Category:General wiki templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
